description: This file defines interfaces for controller components within the WPEFramework, including system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime management, and metadata. It declares several interfaces with methods for rebooting, deleting, cloning, environment access, discovery start and results, configuration persistence, plugin lifecycle control, notifications, and various status reporting functionalities.
external_methods: Core::hresult Clone(const string& callsign, const string& newcallsign, string& response)
Core::hresult Environment(const string& index, string& environment) const
Core::hresult Configuration(const string& callsign, string& configuration) const
Core::hresult Configuration(const string& callsign, const string& configuration)
Core::hresult Hibernate(const string& callsign, const Core::hresult timeout)
Core::hresult Status(const string& index, string& response)
Core::hresult CallStack(const string& index, string& callstack)
virtual void StateChange(const string& callsign, const PluginHost::IShell::state& state, const PluginHost::IShell::reason& reason)

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface providing system management capabilities such as reboot, delete, clone, and environment variable retrieval.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for managing network discovery processes, including starting discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for storing and retrieving configuration data associated with plugins.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifecycle events, including activation, deactivation, suspension, and handling state change notifications.

classes.name: ILifeTime::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface to inform about plugin state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface to access framework metadata such as proxies, status, links, process info, subsystems, version, and call stacks.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboot the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a request environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates network discovery using SSDP.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Provides the SSDP network discovery results.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the configuration for a specific callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for lifetime events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin identified by callsign.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Sets a plugin into Hibernate state with a timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides details of currently running proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status of a plugin, including configurations.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides active connection details.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides details of framework process info.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides information about active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides version information of the framework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides the call stack of a thread.
